description: Use to start price alerts on one hotel from search_hotels for those dates, after the traveler confirms. Alerts go to the account's channels when the price drops.

alert_rule.description: When to alert: lowest = only a new low, any = every price move, none = off. Leave empty for the default, or give target_price_usd instead.
alert_rule.title: Alert Rule

email.description: Send alerts by email. Empty keeps the account's setting.
email.title: Email

search_url.description: The search_url from the same search_hotels result, so the alert reopens the same filtered search (stars, price range, amenities). Empty tracks against the plain search.
search_url.title: Search Url

target_price_usd.description: Alert when the price goes under this, USD. Replaces alert_rule. It is the TOTAL: the whole trip for all travelers on a flight, the whole stay on a hotel.
target_price_usd.title: Target Price Usd

text.description: Send alerts by text message. Needs a verified phone on the SlickTrip account; empty keeps the account's setting.
text.title: Text

name: track_hotel

added_to_existing_stay.description: Merged into an existing stay record

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

note.description: Manage on saved-hotels page or already tracked

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

title: Track a hotel's price
